Name: the Moon
Author: pucklynn
Description:
[code]This mod incorporates the presence of the Moon into Stardew Valley. At the moment, all it does is ominously announce the phases of the moon as they occur, but I'm working on adding functionality as we speak. This is my first mod, so any and all feedback is appreciated!

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Right now it just adds an atmospheric pop-up, but doesn't have any interactive functionality yet.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 [beta] on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player for sure, don't know about multiplayer yet
[/list]
[/code]

Downloads.Description: Added a calendar! Now when you check the billboard in front of Pierre's shop, you'll see the four phases of the moon (new, full, half-full, and half-new) listed.
